source.title: Representative Hydrogen Sampling at Hydrogen Refuelling Stations: Interplay of Sampling Strategy and Station Parameters
source.license: CC BY 4.0 article; raw measurements available from authors on request

observed_evidence.facility: ZBT hydrogen test field, Duisburg, Germany
observed_evidence.data_availability_statement: The raw data supporting the conclusions will be made available by the authors on request.

eligibility_decision.reason: The public article documents a real multi-bank HRS and states that dispenser and tank data were logged, but it does not publish a downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle logger archive, channel dictionary, calibration package or written raw-data reuse terms.
allowed_use: independent HRS configuration and operating-range context
high-priority request for de-identified synchronized station/dispenser/sink logger data
prohibited_use: parameter tuning of the frozen production model
claim of station-to-vehicle validation from published figures

next_action: Request de-identified elapsed-time rows for source pressure/temperature, dispenser pressure/temperature/mass flow, sink pressure/temperature/mass, protocol state, calibration metadata and publication reuse terms; freeze model, inclusion criteria and scoring before accessing numerical outcomes.
claim_boundary: This record strengthens public-source accounting and identifies a high-value acquisition lead. It is not raw validation evidence and does not change the IJHE or full-objective completion gates.
